name: Few hyperedges forcing three colors
description: construct() -> {'edges': distinct triples on 0..8, 'colors': nine labels from 0..2}. Every edge must be nonmonochromatic in the provided coloring. The evaluator exhaustively rejects any hypergraph admitting a two-coloring. Minimize edge count among exactly three-chromatic triple systems. This is a rediscovery task: the literature states the optimum f(3,3)=7, attainable within nine vertices. The ten-edge complete-triple-system baseline can improve to that known optimum; no mathematical novelty is asserted.

state_of_the_art.statement: The Fano plane is a 3-uniform hypergraph with 7 edges that is not 2-colourable, while every triple system with at most 6 edges is 2-colourable. Hence f(3,3) = 7, as stated by Alon. Erdős Problem #832, the general edge count for large chromatic number, was disproved.
